Subject: CloudThera order form — DPA evidence catalogue and SCCs questions

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement and our legal team asked me to pull together one clean thread to align on the DPA and the order form hosting boundary. We've started a short list of evidence items and a few SCCs/roles questions — attached as a spreadsheet (CloudThera_DPA_questions.xlsx). Quick asks:

- Can Redwood confirm whether the evidence pack can include per-region KV cache retention docs (we need to show regional residency controls)?
- For SCCs: can you confirm the named subprocessor list that will appear in the order form exhibit? We need the list before our counsel signs off.
- Are there any order-form language points you expect us to accept vs exceptions we should flag (e.g., liability waterfall tied to dedicated capacity)?

If possible let's have a 30-min touch on Thu morning CET to go through items that require a legal redline. Proposed participants: me, our procurement lead (procurement@cloudthera.com), your legal/ops rep and an AE.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Martin
Head of Procurement, CloudThera

Alice — thanks for the clear list and the spreadsheet. I pulled in Laura (legal) and Ben (solutions/procurement) to triage. Quick notes before we sync:

- Regional evidence: we can provide a per-region export map and a retention summary for KV/cache keys. Ops will redact internal-only metrics; legal will confirm phrasing.
- Subprocessor list: we maintain an annex in the order form (we can provide a snapshot export). For Private deployments we offer a static annex; for hosted we provide a dynamic list with last-updated date.
- Order form language: we typically don't accept amplified liability in the order form without a commercial offset; Ben can speak to commercial concessions.

Thursday 09:30 CET works for me — proposing 30 minutes. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive — EMEA
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: CloudThera order form — DPA evidence catalogue and SCCs questions

Hi Alice / Jonas,

I've reviewed the spreadsheet and called out the items that will need contract-level language vs operational evidence. Summary:

1) SCCs and transfer impact
- We will propose the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) plus a Transfer Impact Addendum where CloudThera requires specific hosting region commitments. If CloudThera wants to lock region at the MSA level, there will be a deployment/ops SLA tie (we should capture that in the order form).

2) Subprocessor transparency
- We can provide a snapshot list as an order-form exhibit. For dynamic lists, we can include a clause: "Subprocessor list to be provided on request with 30 days' notice and published link." If CloudThera needs an approval right, that becomes an exception and we will need to evaluate scope (likely a procurement/fee concession).

3) Evidence pack items
- Per-region KV/cache retention: ops can deliver an evidence sheet (dataflow + retention).
- Data deletion proof: we can provide deletion runbooks and sample audit logs (redacted).

Next steps I propose before the call:
- Jonas: share the latest Redwood_DPA_draft_v3.pdf (I've annotated import sections) — I'll attach my comments.
- Alice: flag any "must-have" language your counsel requires (e.g., absolute residency guarantees).
- Ben: bring commercial options and typical concession buckets.

I'll aim to have track-changes annotated DPA back to you within 48 hours of the call.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_DPA_draft_v3.pdf (PDF, 98 KB)

  * Alice/Clark: circulate counsel redlines by Wed 25 June.
